extras.zh: UTXOSwap 官方文档：用户资产先放进 intent lock 的 cell，sequencer 把它与 Pool Cell 一起花掉，把结果转回用户 lock。本 code_hash 是链上与 Pool Cell 同一交易被花掉的用户 intent cell 的 lock；角色由文档结构推断，未向维护方确认。
extras.en: Official UTXOSwap docs: user assets first go into a cell under the intent lock; the sequencer spends it together with the Pool Cell and returns the result to the user lock. This code_hash is the lock of the user intent cell spent in the same tx as the Pool Cell on chain; the role is inferred from that layout and unconfirmed with the maintainer.

extras.zh: 清单标注 “Intent Lock（已废弃）”；但该 code_hash 在最近的池交易里仍在使用。是否另有已废弃的旧版 intent lock，未找到官方来源。
extras.en: The list says "Intent Lock (deprecated)", yet this code_hash is still used in recent pool txs. Whether an older, deprecated intent lock exists could not be confirmed from an official source.
